runs.cause: Boost 1.92 Asio in WINAPI_FAMILY_APP builds uses winapp_thread, whose join() waits but leaves arg_ set; its destructor then calls std::terminate. Every joined asio::thread_pool therefore aborts in app builds. Desktop builds use win_thread.
runs.observer: The app closed again after Stop.

result: PASS for these runs: the UWP-built library loads in the AppContainer with the app C runtime from the VCLibs framework, reports the built-in store as unsupported, discovers, casts with PasswordVault credentials, controls and stops repeatedly in one process after the reader-pool fix.
correction_to_d54: D54 recorded that the app's PasswordVault was empty after a fresh registration. In this session the vault still held one credential and pairing the D53 profile was refused with profile_exists, so the D53 credential had survived. Casts here used that D53 credential; no new pairing was made.
not_run: Windows App Certification Kit (needs an elevated shell)
x86 and ARM64 builds (vcpkg arm-uwp triplets; Botan's ARM32 UWP support is unknown)
A clean device without the VCLibs framework installed beforehand
Public networks or internetClientServer with the UWP-built library
Pairing through the UWP-built library (the profile already existed)
Natural end of media with the slot release (only remote Home was used)
handling: The receiver address stayed in the app's address box; logs hold fixed fields only. No firewall, network, credential or receiver setting changed by the agent; the user woke the receiver.
